{{Quote|I was sent here to investigate a ''transport capsule!"<br />"''No, Luke! To crack an ''intelligence operation''!|Luke Skywalker and Anduvil|<ref name="TS" />}}
The '''mission to Tatooine''' occurred some time after the events of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] reluctantly underwent the mission after an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[transport capsule]] was identified to have crash-landed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. What began as a mission to investigate the capsule was complicated by the news that the transport capsule, along with similar capsules that had fallen on other [[Planet/Legends|planets]], had caused outbreaks of the highly contagious and deadly [[Bledsoe's disease]] which were followed shortly thereafter by attacks on nearby [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] bases. Luke Skywalker and an assigned Rebel contact, a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ogemite/Legends|Ogemite]] named [[Anduvil]], discovered the connection between these events when Luke was infected with Bledsoe's disease. The Empire was using a genetically modified strain of Bledsoe's to send secret information on Rebel targets. Luke was cured, and with Anduvil he destroyed the local [[Imperial garrison base]], capturing its commander to ensure their escape from the planet.

==History==
===Prelude===
{{Quote|A discoloration of the victim's ''eyes'' is a symptom of Bledsoe's disease! By ''genetic manipulation'' of the virus, we can encode a ''message'' in that symptom!|Doctor Kaaldar|<ref name="TS" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sent various [[transport capsule]]s to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizers. These capsules contained [[Squill (creature)|Squills]] infected with a genetically modified form of [[Bledsoe's disease]], which led to an outbreak. This outbreak undermines the social order of planets suspected of leaning toward the Rebellion. Meanwhile the specific genetic modifications of the disease caused the eyes of the infected to develop discoloration, which could be read as star maps which revealed the locations of secret Rebel bases. These bases could then be attacked by Imperial forces. Meanwhile, after the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], Imperial forces managed to consolidate their hold on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and construct an [[Imperial garrison base]]. An Imperial transport capsule containing infected Squills was sent to Tatooine, there to be recovered by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] and used to infect the populace. However, [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] found the capsule first, foiling the plan since Jawa eyes were unreadable. Observers at [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] detected the capsule crash, reporting it to the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="TS" />

===The Mission===
{{Quote|Alliance ''Code Grave'', Luke... abandon reconnaissance mission!|Massassi One|<ref name="TS" />}}
[[Massassi One]] of the Rebel Alliance ordered a reluctant [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to abandon his space reconnaissance mission and head to Tatooine to investigate the capsule due to it being designated a [[Code Grave]] mission. Luke was initially reluctant to return to his home planet due to having bad memories of his time on the planet, but he eventually agreed, accompanied by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Upon exiting [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] Luke received a mysterious transmission directing him to [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], and a contact named [[Anduvil]] of [[Ogem/Legends|Ogem]]. Luke soon discovered that the Empire's new base on Tatooine had greatly increased traffic and military presence in Mos Eisley.<ref name="TS" />

Chalmun's cantina still had a strict no-[[Droid/Legends|droids]] policy, so Luke entered alone. He was almost ambushed by a [[Unidentified simian bounty hunter|bounty hunter]] working for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], but was saved by his contact Anduvil. She informed him that his mission was not merely to investigate a transport capsule, but to crack an Imperial intelligence operation and discover the link between the crashed transport capsules, the outbreaks of Bledsoe's disease, and the attacks on Rebel bases. Before Luke could learn much more, however, a Jawa in the cantina collapsed. The Bledsoe's outbreak had reached Mos Eisley.<ref name="TS" />

Fleeing the outbreak in Anduvil's [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], Luke guided them to [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|Ben Kenobi's hut]] to discuss their next move. They were attacked by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] who smashed Anduvil's Landspeeder, but after defeating the raiding party Luke and Anduvil took their [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]]. Anduvil guided them to the Jawa [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] that had first found the transport capsule, only to find Imperial Stormtroopers staring into the Jawa's eyes. However, Jawa eyes did not properly show the discoloration of Bledsoe's disease, and the Stormtroopers eventually left. Investigating the sandcrawler for an explanation of the strange behavior, Luke was bitten by a Squill. Anduvil sadly informed him that Squills carry Bledsoe's disease, and that Luke was possibly infected. Before Luke could come up with a plan, however, the Stormtroopers returned. Upon discovering that Luke had been bitten, the Stormtroopers captured them all and took them to the Imperial garrison base, leaving C-3PO and R2-D2 behind in the desert.<ref name="TS" />

At the base Luke was delivered to [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Kaaldar]], who discovered that Luke's eyes had become discolored from Bledsoe's disease, becoming a star map. Luke and Anduil discovered that the Imperials had been using genetically modified Bledsoe's to send coded messages and star charts to many worlds, secretly coordinating attacks on Rebel strongholds. Anduvil begged Kaaldar to give Luke an [[Antidote/Legends|antidote]] to the disease, but Kaaldar refused as long as Luke's eyes revealed the location of a secret Rebel base. Luke was able to overcome his captors, even in his weakened state, and forced Kaaldar to give him the antidote.<ref name="TS" />

Outside the garrison base C-3PO and R2-D2 had commandeered the abandoned sandcrawler, and driven it through the main gate of the base. This successfully distracted the Stormtroopers, but led to the capture of the droids. While Luke Skywalker rushed to their rescue and took the [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Tatooine)|Imperial commander]] hostage, Anduvil sabotaged the [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]] of the base's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]]. Luke, Anduvil, the droids, and the captured [[Commander/Legends|commander]] fled the base just before the sabotaged ion drives exploded, destroying the garrison base.<ref name="TS" />

===Aftermath===
{{Quote|Has the serum that Dr. Kaaldar gave you done its work, Luke?''"<br />"''Never felt better, Anduvil! How about dinner with me when we touch down on Yavin's moon?|Anduvil and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="TS" />}}
With the base destroyed, Luke, Anduvil, the droids, and their hostage returned to Mos Eisley. They used [[Luke Skywalker's starship (Tatooine)|Luke's starship]] to escape the planet, with their hostage to guarantee their safety during their return to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. They would force the commander to reveal the details of the Empire's scheme, ensuring that Bledsoe's disease would no longer serve as a vector for secret Imperial information.<ref name="TS" />
